feeds.title: Chirpee Flowers Blog
feeds.description: I'm proud to be a third-generation florist, my grandad had a large chrysanthemum nursery in Lincolnshire, the center of the floral world in the 1930s, and supplied the old Covent Garden market in London. We love creating beautiful designs for lovely couples around Sussex, and beyond and bring our expertise when you are planning the most visual and decorative part of your wedding day.

feeds.title: Le Champagne Projects Blog
feeds.description: I'm Kelly le creative behind Le Champagne Projects. I grew up studying art, drawing, and sculpting. Here at Le Champagne Projects, it is my goal to bring our couples romantic wedding flowers + designs while incorporating eco-friendly solutions. I take pride in providing high-quality, lush florals, using the freshest and best product we can source locally, and building our arrangements foam-free. We are committed to sustainability without compromising style.

feeds.title: Floral Quarter Blog
feeds.description: Find out the latest on Wedding Flowers and Floral Quarter by clicking on our blog. Hi, I'm Vicky and I'm the woman behind Floral Quarter. When you book me for your big day, you also book a friendly face, a reassuring & enjoyable experience from start to finish, prompt communication, and peace of mind; as well as beautiful flowers of course!

feeds.title: Blum Floral Design Blog
feeds.description: Blum Floral Design is Portland's top bridal and wedding florist for lush, elegant flowers with a modern touch in 2005. At Blum Design in Flowers, we work collaboratively with our clients to translate the vision for their event and create spaces that reflect their individual style with flowers.

feeds.title: Blooms By The Box Blog
feeds.description: BloomsByTheBox.com takes great pride in its reputation for delivering the finest quality premium-grade flowers and greens and the highest levels of customer service. To make sure that continues, we have built a network of trusted growers and distributors who consistently meet our demanding quality and reliability needs.

feeds.title: Flora D' Amore Blog
feeds.description: Flora d'Amore is a third-generation florist shop that has been providing beautiful florals to the Everett and Lynnwood communities and beyond for over 70 years. At Flora d'Amore, we understand every wedding is unique and personal, which is why we only offer experienced wedding consultants to help guide you through the flower selection process that will bring your wedding vision to life.

feeds.title: Life in Bloom Blog
feeds.description: Life in Bloom specializes in event design, wedding flowers, corporate events, and bridal bouquets. Read blog posts, our experiences, designs, and more.

feeds.title: Junebug Weddings Blog » Wedding Flowers
feeds.description: Read articles on wedding flowers, what we do, and more. At Junebug Weddings, we're here to demystify the wedding planning process with inspiration, information, and resources. We publish content to empower couples to create a celebration worthy of their unique love-inclusive of all genders, cultures, religions, and styles. Through this work, we also connect couples to talented vendors who can turn their visions into reality.

feeds.title: Thistle Bee Blog
feeds.description: Since 2014, Thistle Bee has grown to a team of 6 talented florists designing more than 50 weddings each year. We approach each wedding as an opportunity to listen and guide you through the stress of planning by handling all of the little details, while you enjoy your day.

feeds.title: Stapleton Floral Design Blog
feeds.description: Stapleton Floral has been a family tradition in Boston and the surrounding areas for over 25 years. We have grown with the community during their most significant occasions and have developed lasting friendships. Our team of floral designers works very closely together to provide exceptional service. Our inventory is shipped directly from the growers, insuring freshness and selection.

feeds.title: Red Poppy Floral Design Blog
feeds.description: Red Poppy is a small floral design studio - we emphasize thoughtful design and accept only a few events each weekend to have plenty of time and attention for each. It's small scale - you'll work directly with Tracy throughout the design process, and she'll work closely with you to create flowers for your celebration.

feeds.title: Lang Floral Designs Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Stephanie Lang, owner and lead florist here at Lang Floral Designs. I have been doing wedding flowers and design for almost a decade, and now enjoy sharing all the fun details here on our blog. Here at Lang Floral Designs, we truly believe that we do the best wedding flowers in the Chattanooga area, and many of our clients agree!

feeds.title: Nielsen's Florist Blog
feeds.description: Nielsen's Florist offers a variety of in-person workshops and classes, that cover topics such as floral design, and container gardening and there are even workshops for the little ones! Visit our showroom, get inspired, and let our designers work with you to create timeless, bespoke botanical concepts that are authentically you. It's modern elegance with an organic twist, for all the moments of your life.

feeds.title: Flower Moxie Blog
feeds.description: From paintable vase ware to ribbon, we have what you need to make killer floral designs! We have exclusive, in-house designed invitation suite templates to match each of our floral packages! We now offer many of our most popular blooms in bulk! We offer bulk garden roses, carnations, scabiosa, ranunculus, and so much more.

feeds.title: T Villager Designs Blog
feeds.description: T Villager Designs is a Nashville-based luxury floral design company that creates one-of-a-kind designs for weddings, dinner parties, corporate events, galas, and everything in between. We are on a mission to help our clients express and emulate the emotions of their events through distinctive floral arrangements, designs, and installations. Our team of talented Nashville florists has years of experience in the events industry, and we all share a collective passion for leaving a lasting impact on our clients and their guests.

feeds.title: Floral Artistry Blog
feeds.description: I am Alison, the woman behind Floral Artistry. My vision is that the true art of floral design is found through high-quality flowers and superior design techniques. Using natural and local materials in creative ways I incorporate flowers that represent the best of the season. At Floral Artistry, we believe in a diverse, inclusive, and equitable environment, where all employees, clients, and vendors-whatever their gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or identity-feel valued and respected.

feeds.title: Walter Knoll Florist Blog
feeds.description: At Walter Knoll Florist, we compete strongly with the finest designers, retailers, and service providers around the world in the areas of design, service and presentation. We strive to provide our customers with the highest standard of quality in product, design, service and presentation while never forgetting value.

feeds.title: Austen Flowers Blog
feeds.description: My name is Camelia - florist, creative director, and founder of Austen Flowers. I am often asked if this is my real name. You could say that, with a name like Camelia, I have been predestined to work with flowers. I couldn't dream of doing anything else; the flowers give me strength and energy and I, in turn, am fortuitous in bringing smiles and happiness everywhere I bring my floral creations.

feeds.title: Fig and Flower Blog
feeds.description: I'm Zuzana, the top floral designer and wedding stylist. I live in West Sussex. On this blog, you will find floral inspiration for your wedding flowers, styling tips on the best wedding flowers that truly represent you, to useful tips and ideas on how to plan your bespoke florals with your florist or a planner. If you are a florist yourself or are thinking about working with flowers you will also find helpful articles about the world of floristry.

feeds.title: Duarte Floral Design Blog
feeds.description: We are proud to be Key West's most unique wedding florist, with a fresh style and contemporary floral designs. We pride ourselves in listening to our clients and collaborating with them in designing what they have envisioned. Our designs incorporate an island feel with a modern and elegant twist.

feeds.title: Enchanted Florist Blog
feeds.description: Enchanted Florist is blessed to have a superb staff of designers, wedding specialists, and set-up crew that make floral magic happen for every event. With her keen eye for original and creative designs and her warm and down-to-earth personality, Caprice's passion for her work is evident in all she does.

feeds.title: Caroline Reusen Floral Design Blog
feeds.description: Caroline is a wedding and event florist based in Oregon, offering services in the U.S. and Europe. As a resident of the Pacific Northwest, she has a great appreciation for natural landscapes and the beauty of local florals. She enjoys working with flowers grown by local farmer florists, which showcase the abundance of the seasons. Guided by her wide-ranging experience, Caroline uses her passion for flowers as an art medium to create timeless but innovative designs for her clients.

feeds.title: Flowers by Alana Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Alana, your friendly Portland wedding florist! Flowers and gorgeous floral design are my passion and I'm proud to say I've been in the floral industry for 20 years! My floral career started in the floral department of natural food grocery stores Nature's, Zupan's, and Whole Foods. We also strive to find environmentally friendly design methods that minimize petrochemicals and waste.

feeds.title: Blushington Blooms Blog
feeds.description: The moment you step into our office you're greeted by a beautiful design studio. Natural light lets the neutral tones of our office shine, mirrors line the walls to ensure our flowers are stunning from every angle, and gold accents bring a luxury vibe to the space. Our office reflects the taste we bring to our arrangements- timeless and luxurious.

feeds.title: Gray Harper Blog
feeds.description: Here at Gray Harper, it's all about event experience - we want your wedding florals to captivate your guests by creating interest and sparking conversation. We are known for our unique floral installations that feel more like custom artwork than flower arrangements. We also work with a variety of clients from the food, fashion, and wedding industries to style products for ad campaigns, flat lay photography, websites, and social media.

feeds.title: Ash to Oak Floristry Blog
feeds.description: As a floral designer, Avery believes flowers are an invitation to engage with the beauty that transforms mundane moments into deep delight. It is my joy to bring them to you! Nikki has always been passionate about creativity and turning ideas in her head into physical creations.

feeds.title: A Petal to Peddle Blog
feeds.description: A Petal To Peddle is a Jersey City based botanical studio specializing in designs for weddings, events and businesses. Founded in 2016 by Christa Quigley, we strive to create pieces that honor the natural movement of each stem and bloom. With a focus on sustainability, our designs often feature foraged ingredients and botanica grown on local farms.

feeds.title: Morrie & Maisie Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Corrie. Born and bred in New Zealand, I spent my first life working as a lawyer. Morrie & Maisie Event Flowers is named after my creative grandparents, Morrie and Maisie. I help couples get those big-city florals without the big-city stress. I like to think I'm channeling their creativity through my flower work, there's no end to what we can create.

feeds.title: Bird and Bumble Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Rebecca! I am inspired by locally grown flowers, hand-made vessels, texture, and the seasons. My floral artistry is influenced by travel, other art forms, gardening, and my everyday life. My aim is to create fine art floral designs; think of your wedding floral as a custom commission in flowers.

feeds.title: Flowers by Kristina Blog
feeds.description: I'm Kristina, founder and face behind Flowers By Kristina. I genuinely believe that wedding flowers can be the most transformative decoration you can invest in for your wedding day. We provide timeless and luxurious wedding flowers, oozing with romance and texture. Guaranteed to transform your venue and wow your guests.

feeds.title: Fiori Floral Studio Blog
feeds.description: Are you planning a wedding in Charlottesville and need flowers? Fiori Floral Studio has you covered. Check out our Instagram to see recent Charlottesville weddings and events. Book a Charlottesville florist you can trust. We're familiar with Charlottesville wedding venues and up to date on all health and safety regulations including monitoring the health of our florists.

feeds.title: Little Lady Floral Blog
feeds.description: I believe that flowers add a breathtaking dimension to weddings, curating an artistic, sophisticated look that should convey your style as a couple. From the textures to the way the light reflects from the hand-cut blooms, there's a dreamlike quality to it that simply makes weddings magical. I would adore creating a custom floral design that resonates with you.

feeds.title: Vella Nest Floral Blog
feeds.description: Vella Nest Floral is known for an aesthetic that's effortless but polished, whimsical but timeless refined European-inspired floral design. Alexandra, experience in event design, logistical strategy, and approach that's built on kindness and creative thinking make her a sought-after floral and event designer for the most discerning of clientele.

feeds.title: R Love Floral Blog
feeds.description: R. Love Floral is a space for all things floral and beauty. Serving both our wedding and event clients while teaching and mentoring in person, virtual and one-on-one classes. The R. Love Floral blog is not only a space for wedding and floral inspiration but also a lifestyle brand, dedicated to gardening, DIY crafts, and cultivating a healthy lifestyle that focuses on family, faith, and flowers.

feeds.title: Blog by Lavender Blue Floral
feeds.description: At Lavender Blue, we tell stories through our flowers. Detail-obsessed, colorful, timeless. That's the Lavender Blue way. Through lush, seasonal flowers and mindful design, you aren't just getting arrangements. You'll discover your vision transformed into a magical experience your guests will remember for years to come.

feeds.title: Dream Flowers Blog
feeds.description: Dream Flowers is a team of wonderful floral artists dedicated to making sure your flowers and events are unforgettable. We've been in business for almost 10 years as primarily wedding florists, but we also offer daily deliveries and sympathy flowers. We specialize in bespoke wedding and event flowers, made more than 200 events already, and have more than 1500 custom arrangements.

feeds.title: Bride & Blossom Blog
feeds.description: We focus on each bride's unique vision and style by providing customized design and personalized service. Romantic, contemporary, vintage, classic, or sophisticated, we offer a gorgeous selection of bouquets, ceremony designs, reception centerpieces, cake florals, and more, personalizing your wedding decoration every step of the way. We exclusively specialize in wedding décor and ensure a boutique-like experience.

feeds.title: Violet Floral Designs Blog
feeds.description: In 2017 Violet Floral Designs, a floral studio serving weddings and events in Baltimore, Maryland, was founded by floral designer Mallory Wilson out of a deep joy found in making special occasions beautiful with flowers, and a passion for using creativity to provide a service to others. Mallory works with a growing team of creative, hardworking people to bring beautiful floral visions to life at Baltimore weddings.

feeds.title: Chic Girl Flowers Blog
feeds.description: At Chic Girl Flowers, we put our clients first! Our flowers may not last forever, but the smiles on our clients' faces do-so, that's what we focus on. We bring your wedding vision to life with breathtaking flowers that exhibit a sense of timelessness, elegance, and romance.

feeds.title: Rosemary & Finch Blog
feeds.description: Led by Mary Love Richardson, Rosemary & Finch has created lush, garden-inspired florals for more than 300 weddings and events over 10 years of business. In that time, organic, large-scale floral installations have become our specialty. Our team is cheerful and joyful, meticulously organized, and thrilled to be creating floral magic for you.
